label: Default — the repair bench

recentEvents.value: Watched the Glass, then received the pieces: a goblin hinge charm, cold-set, no seam — snapped with a boot. Better work than his.
She has re-set four of the realms' makers' marks for Joren now. All four arrived in pieces.

unresolvedConflicts.value: He breaks excellent work and calls the pieces evil; she has repaired what he breaks, so she knows exactly how good it was.

temporaryObjective.value: Mend what she can, and tell him exactly how good the work was that he broke.

notes: She KNOWS fact_shards_are_domestic_magic — she has physically re-set the realms' charms (profile notes). She has never read the book.
